name: Deep Understanding of AI Drug Discovery
description: The present study is finalised to determine the most advanced models in the literature capable of producing new high-quality molecules starting from well-known datasets. The selection is carried out through a series of evaluation processes. At first, the output samples of each method are evaluated according to certain physico-chemical properties such as Quantitative Estimation of Drug-likeness (QED) and Synthetic Accessibility (SA).
